cookieAuth.name: asi_access
cookieAuth.description: Access JWT set by `POST /auth/login`, refreshed through `POST /auth/refresh`.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Sets two httpOnly cookies: `asi_access` (15 min JWT) and `asi_refresh` (7 days, path `/v1/auth`). Five failed attempts in a row lock the account for 15 minutes. Every failure (unknown email, wrong password, locked or deactivated account) returns the same 401.

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access token
post.description: Reads the `asi_refresh` cookie. Presenting an already rotated refresh token revokes the whole session.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

post.description: Revokes the current session and clears both cookies. Always succeeds.
